name: m11-remaining
note: The remaining campaign in run order (Evaluation.md 9, revision 3). W0, W1 and W2 (including W2b) are complete and are deliberately not cells here. One cell is one campaign file plus the run count it must expand to. Every cell states the **real** wave size, so a campaign file that is still a placeholder (w3, w4, w6) expands to fewer runs than expected and the runner refuses to start it: replacing a list without updating expect, or running a placeholder, fails loudly instead of spending. Reach a later cell with --from, because --through alone still starts at the first cell and pauses at its stop_after. A stop_after cell is a staged-spend decision point, not a batch boundary: the run stops there unless --through names that cell. checkpoint_usd is the cumulative M11 ceiling from Evaluation.md 10.3.

waves.note: W3 bridge (I1), document mode, mechanism only. **40 non-subset instances x 2 arms = 80** on the release's validation split, which is the only split carrying trec_coarse; the 10-instance subset at n=3 is its own cell. Two documents are shared by the 50 instances. May not support a claim about retrieval, citations, the gate or the corpus.
W3 pre-registered subset: every fifth instance in sorted id order, 10 of 50, both arms at n=3 = 60 runs. Its purpose is the run-to-run spread of exact match on a task with a short answer.
W4 doc-needle guardrail (I3). 30 instances x 2 arms. The generator does not exist yet, so the file is a placeholder and this cell refuses to start. H2a is read here.

W5 I5 corpus gold, the in-domain H1 reading. The 14 non-subset instances x A0, A2 = 28, on the rig-v20 freeze where i5-gold-v1.jsonl is hashed. The pre-registered four-instance subset at n=3 is its own cell; final-gate calibration runs after the cells.
W5 pre-registered subset (i5-f1-beir, i5-f2-01, i5-f3-instrument, i5-f4-01), 4 instances x A0, A2 x 3 = 24. The rule is fixed in the campaign file before any I5 answer existed.

W5b3 I6 compound on rig v19: the same 7 non-subset instances x 4 arms, re-run after the token cap was re-derived (325,000 -> 382,025) and after D-31 (a failed or empty run no longer enters the arm mean) and one empty-completion retry. ~$2.3-3.5. Do not pool with w5b (v17, pre-tool) or w5b2 (v18, old cap).
W5b3 subset (cmp-05, cmp-07) at n=3 x 4 arms on rig v19.

W6 ablations A3 (depth-0) and A5 (gate-off) over **all 18** I5 instances x 2 arms = 36 runs on rig v22. The A2 reference rows are W5's v22 runs of the same query_id. Only the depth-0 arm carries gate verdicts, so E4's population gains 18 answers from this cell, not 36.
